name: Sino Hotels (Holdings) Limited
summary: Sino Hotels (Holdings) Limited is an investment holding company headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui that manages and operates hotels in Hong Kong and Singapore. The Hong Kong portfolio includes Conrad Hong Kong, City Garden Hotel and The Pottinger, while Singapore has the two Fullerton hotels. It also operates the Gold Coast Yacht & Country Club and a range of restaurants, bars and cafes, and offers nominee and financial services.
